items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: in November I get a call from this same Jack Techo

ctx.x: So, in the FALL, after that tour was over, I went to Champagne. And I really enjoyed it. I went home for a couple of days and then went over to the University of Illinois and registered, started. Well, in November I get a call from this same Jack Techo, who's producing an act called The Collegians, who were going in vaudeville, they were going to California. This was 1925. I couldn't stand it. I just -- I left school --
